messages:

Subject: Requesting custom HA exhibit + order form language for MSA/SOW

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and legal here at Helix Diagnostics have asked for a tailored availability exhibit we can attach to our MSA/SOW and a corresponding order form line that calls out the exception and capacity tier.

Key asks from our side:
- Availability commitment: target 99.95% for the Dedicated-H serving tier (we understand this is higher than standard tiers; open to fallbacks)
- Latency commitments: p99 < 450ms for generation on the Dedicated-H tier (for 4k tokens average)
- Evidence: monthly availability report + access to SLA telemetry export (or a read-only API) for audit
- Order form language: a short clause that references the attached exhibit and the Dedicated-H order line; procurement wants a single-line descriptor they can map to their PO

Attached: HelixDX_SOW_Draft_v3.pdf (our current SOW) — procurement asked if you can send proposed exhibit wording and an order form redline so they can route quickly. Also let us know the approximate lead time to reserve Dedicated-H capacity once signed.

Appreciate a pragmatic approach — happy to take a first pass and then iterate with our legal.

Best,
Michael Leong
Director, Procurement
Helix Diagnostics

2) Produce an order form redline that shows the Dedicated-H SKU and an "Availability Exception" checkbox/annotation so procurement can map to their PO tool.
3) Include a proposed DocuSign route note and suggested SLA audit cadence (monthly report + 30-day export retention window).

Two quick clarifying Qs before I spin the doc:
- Is the 99.95% target a hard ask from legal or a preferred target from procurement? If it is non-negotiable we will need to loop Product/Infra to validate for your workload profile.
- Does Helix expect real-time telemetry access (API) or would secure S3 exports suffice for your audit workflow?

Attaching our HA exhibit template for your reference; will aim to send a redline back by EOD Tuesday once I confirm internal constraints.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes

Camila / team — quick product/ops note inline.

We can support a 99.95% availability target for Dedicated-H provided we limit the SLA scope to inference serving on the Dedicated-H pool (exclude experimental beta features, third-party integrations, and customer-side misconfigurations). We'll want the following spelled out in the exhibit:
- Scope: Dedicated-H serving tier, list of model families allowed, and excluded features
- Regional fallback: allow routing to an alternate region for continuity with a defined failover window and corresponding credits if cross-region failover occurs
- Degraded-mode credits: capped credit schedule that follows our standard formula but with a higher cap for the Dedicated-H exception (example: credits up to 50% of monthly bill for sustained region outage)
- Evidence: we can provide monthly CSV export + an S3 export for telemetry; full real-time API access is sensitive operationally, but we can discuss a read-only API on an approved support ticket basis for audits
- Lead time: 6–8 weeks typical for Dedicated-H provisioning depending on region and model mix; we can offer a prioritized queue if deal is medium/large (requires reservation commitment)

I will attach suggested operational bullets and a realistic credit schedule to the draft. Kimberly / Marissa — please advise on any legal phrases you prefer for the credit caps and the audit/API framing.

— Karthik

Subject: Proposed Availability Exhibit + order form redline for Helix Diagnostics

Michael — thanks for your patience. Attached are two files: a proposed Availability Exhibit (one page) that we recommend attaching to the MSA/SOW, and an order form redline that shows the Dedicated-H SKU with an "Availability Exception" flag your procurement team can map on the PO.

Summary of our proposal:
- Commitment: 99.95% monthly availability for inference serving on Dedicated-H for the model families named in the exhibit.
- Latency: we include a latency target section (p99 < 450ms) with a qualification that the target applies to typical gen requests (<= 4k tokens) and does not cover misconfigured prompts or abusive traffic patterns.
- Evidence & telemetry: monthly availability CSV + S3 export retained for 30 days. We can provide read-only API export access on approved audit requests; live streaming access is not included.
- Fallbacks & credits: regional fallback allowed; credit schedule included with a cap (example: up to 50% monthly invoice for major regional outage).
- Lead time: we estimate 6–8 weeks for Dedicated-H provisioning, shorter if Helix commits to a reservation/term.

Next steps we suggest:
1) You route these attachments to procurement/legal and confirm whether the 99.95 target needs to be hardened or can be negotiated to 99.9% with improved lead-time/credit terms.
2) If procurement accepts, we will incorporate the final exhibit into your SOW and produce a DocuSign-ready order form.

Attaching the redline and the exhibit. Happy to hop on a 30-min call with procurement/legal if that helps accelerate.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Principal Account Executive
Redwood Inference
